facts.title: Godspeed balance
facts.text: Added 10% shot charge speed; stamina consumption reduction nerfed by 50%.

facts.title: Release rarity
facts.text: Godspeed launched alongside new Master style and flow tiers.

history.title: Flow balance and fixes
history.text: Numerous flow buffs and nerfs. Magician Flow moved to Legendary; Emperor cooldown reduction changed from 33% to 20%. Infinite Awakening added to PS+.

history.title: Loki and Godspeed
history.text: New Master style and flow rarities, Loki, Godspeed and exclusive velocity passive introduced.
